Tasks are written as a user would ASK, never by quoting the skill description: a task that echoes its target's wording measures string matching, not selection (#890 step 3's inflation lesson, applied here). Labels name skills that live outside the repo, so a label can fail to resolve on another machine - that is a MISS, reported as resolved/total, never excluded.
